gaps.sentence: With careful ___ (PREPARE), the trek is perfectly safe.
Drive ___ (CARE) — the mountain road has hairpin bends.
gaps.explanation: An adverb is needed to modify 'drive': carefully.

gaps.sentence: The thief was ___ (ARREST) at the border.
The problem was ___ (SIMPLE) a matter of bad timing.
gaps.explanation: 'Simply a matter of' = only a matter of.

gaps.sentence: The dogs’ astonishing ___ (LOYAL) to their owners is well documented.
gaps.explanation: 'Astonishing loyalty' — the quality noun is required after the adjective.

gaps.sentence: The committee reached its verdict after lengthy ___ (DELIBERATE).
gaps.explanation: 'After lengthy deliberation' — the noun for careful discussion.

gaps.sentence: We've received your ___ (REQUEST) for a refund.
